title: The Cellar of Vessel Farm
author: Quentin Ashgrove
blurb: Rafael Coldharbour, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
